result.title: Windows unit gate: HostileReviewWorker_InvalidOptions_FailStartup gets an AggregateException that never names HostileReviewWorker
result.summary: The test builds Host.CreateApplicationBuilder() with invalid HostileReviewWorker options (RenewalInterval equal to LeaseDuration) and expects host.StartAsync to fail with an exception whose text contains HostileReviewWorker. On PAYTON-LEGION2 StartAsync throws System.AggregateException ("An error occurred while ...") whose ToString() does not contain HostileReviewWorker; on Linux the same test passes. Inference (unverified): on Windows another startup step fails first (for example a Windows-only logging provider under the lab-wsman account), so the options validation failure is not what surfaces. Needs the full exception text before classifying it as environment or defect.
